title: Say in the coder test-execution skill that a settled last check needs a real wake for its acceptance evaluation
outcome: Say in the coder test-execution skill that a settled last check needs a real wake for its acceptance evaluation
acceptance: `.agents/skills/coder-test-execution/SKILL.md` contains, right after READY step 6, verbatim and identical to TermAl's copy: "When the last required check settles and acceptance evaluation must be requested in a later turn, do not end with only a note or 'next turn'. Use the host's event-driven acceptance when available. Otherwise send READY: evaluation to the project coordinator with the item, run and verification/credit locators before ending; the coordinator wakes the owner to request evaluation. The owner reuses the settled evidence and never reruns the check merely to obtain a later turn. A turn boundary without a host or named coordinator wake is an incomplete handoff."
Markdown only: no other text changes; the focused link check passes and a Codex plus Claude pair reviews it
